Role: Lead GenAI Developer

Experience: 6 - 12 Years

Location: Pune

Job Mode: Permanent

Notice Period: Immediate Joiner




Experience

6+ years of total IT experience
Minimum 2.5 - 3years of hands-on experience in Generative AI
Strong prior experience in Python development



Required Skills

Python (Mandatory)
Machine Learning
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI/LLM Models (OpenAI, Claude, Llama)



Note: Strong Python coding skills with hands-on GenAI experience are mandatory.




Job Description

We are looking for a Lead GenAI Developer with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Claude, and Llama.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines, including embeddings, vector databases, retrieval mechanisms, and ranking strategies.
Evaluate, compare, and recommend AI-ready infrastructure components, including vector database solutions.
Develop APIs, services, and integration layers to embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
Create and maintain model evaluation frameworks for business use cases.
Optimize AI solutions for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to deliver AI-driven applications and features.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
Strong programming expertise in Python.
Experience with Machine Learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with RAG pipelines and vector databases including Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, or Milvus.
Experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models.
Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Exposure to cloud AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Google Vertex AI.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with MLflow or similar model lifecycle management tools.
